description: Fetch a Vimeo creator's public profile header (name, avatar, bio, location, follower/following counts, video count, member-since) plus one sub-page list — videos | albums | collections | followers | following — with internal pagination. The user slug comes from the profile URL vimeo.com/{user}, e.g. click any uploader name on a video page. Public profiles need no login; a browser session is required because location and follower/following counts are only served by the page's internal api.vimeo.com call, not the SSR HTML.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User slug from the profile URL: vimeo.com/{user} (e.g. "<user-slug>"). Discovery: click the uploader name on any video page, or vimeo/search --type people.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Which sub-page to return: videos (default, the creator's uploads) | albums | collections | followers | following. The profile header fields are always returned regardless of tab. Note: the public profile's "Showcases" tab maps to /albums.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return for list tabs (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally; partial=true when the listing is exhausted.
